export const meta = {
  name: 'af_critique_dual_agent_v2',
  description: 'Bounded dual-agent critique: A=design+copy review from evidence bundle, B=detector+a11y evidence. Isolated, parallel.'
};

const brief = `
PRODUCT: "The Armchair Futurist — the last AI consultant you'll ever hire." 1:1 AI mastery mentoring. Success = how fast the client stops paying us (self-sufficient in 8-10 weeks). Landing page = 14 sections + embedded 9-question AI-readiness assessment (free, no email to see score).
AUDIENCE: Established professionals (consultants, coaches, freelancers, agency owners) with existing revenue. Time-poor, skeptical of marketing copy, abandon in <5s. Already pay for AI tools; may have been burned by an "AI workshop."
BRAND VOICE (direct/warm/expert): Clarity over hype. Trust as the product. Exit as the goal. Capability not deliverable.
ANTI-SLOP KILL LIST: delve, landscape, tapestry, testament, navigate, it's worth noting, first and foremost, in order to, at the end of the day, journey (business metaphor), unlock, leverage, seamless, robust, cutting-edge, game-changer, "unlock AI's potential", "navigate the AI landscape". Em-dashes capped at ONE per paragraph. Varied sentence rhythm (long/short, fragments, occasional "And"/"But" opener).
DESIGN SYSTEM (HP white-paper): Space Grotesk display + Manrope body. ONE signal color HP Electric Blue #024ad8 (every CTA/link/focus ring). Ink #1a1a1a headlines. White canvas, cloud #f7f7f7 cards, 16px radii (cards/photos), 4px (buttons/inputs). Dark navy slabs for testimonials + closing CTA. Buttons = 14px Manrope 600 uppercase +0.7px tracking 4px radius. NO gradients, NO text shadows, NO warm accents, NO rounded-full except avatars/pill tabs.
ANTI-REFERENCES: generic AI-consultant sites (stock photos, buzzword copy, "+300%" metric cards, gradient text, glassmorphism); course-platform look (sticky CTAs, "join 10,000 students", fake testimonials); SaaS dashboard aesthetic (feature grids, logo walls); AI slop (AI palette, gradient text, Inter everywhere, bounce easing, 3-tier pricing middle-highlighted, blobs).
`;

const bundlePath = '/tmp/af_critique_bundle.md';
const repo = process.cwd();

const assessA = () => agent(
`You are Assessment A in an Impeccable dual-agent UX/copy critique. You are an award-winning design director. ISOLATION RULE: do NOT run detect.mjs or any detector — that is Assessment B's job. Do not speculate about detector results.

Read EXACTLY ONE file: ${bundlePath}. It contains, per source file, the visible copy, heading tags, aria/alt/role/tabIndex attrs, and key classNames for the homepage (src/app/page.tsx), layout, all 16 sections, and the assessment flow. Analyze ONLY from this bundle — do not read other files.

BRIEF (ground truth):
${brief}

Produce a rigorous structured report with EXACTLY these 10 sections:

1. DESIGN-SPECIFICITY VERDICT — Is the visual language + copy grounded in THIS product (last-AI-consultant / exit-as-goal / HP white-paper) or could an unrelated product use it unchanged? One paragraph + verdict (Grounded / Partially / Generic).

2. NIELSEN HEURISTICS (0-4 each; 4=exemplary, 0=catastrophic; n/a only if truly inapplicable to a marketing surface). Score + SPECIFIC finding (quote copy / cite file) for all 10: Visibility of System Status; Match System/Real World; User Control & Freedom; Consistency & Standards; Error Prevention; Recognition over Recall; Flexibility & Efficiency; Aesthetic & Minimalist Design; Error Recovery; Help & Docs.

3. COGNITIVE LOAD — (a) decision points with >4 visible options, (b) 5-second first-action clarity failures, (c) icon-only elements without text labels, (d) jargon assuming prior knowledge. Cite file + quote.

4. EMOTIONAL JOURNEY (peak-end) — Walk section order top→bottom. Peaks, valleys, reassurance at high-stakes moments (email capture, ROI calc, "am I being sold to"). Does "exit as goal" survive the funnel or get undercut by a hard sell?

5. COPY AUDIT (half the ask — be thorough, use the bundle copy). Report with file + quote:
   - Anti-slop violations (kill-list words/phrases).
   - Em-dash density (>1 em-dash per paragraph).
   - Voice breaks (hype/corporate/course-platform register).
   - Unverifiable claims (stats/boasts without verification path — violates "density of fact").
   - Missing "exit" framing (CTAs selling retention over independence).
   - Clarity (jargon, vague abstractions a time-poor skeptic skips).
   Then a COPY-HEALTH verdict (Strong / Needs Work / Slop Detected) + top copy issues ranked.

6. STRENGTHS (2-3, specific).

7. PRIORITY ISSUES (3-5, ranked, each file+quote + one-line fix).

8. PERSONA RED FLAGS — Jordan (first-impression skeptic), Riley (stress-tester: assessment form + ROI calc edge cases), Casey (one-handed mobile, thumb zone, interrupted), + "Morgan" (established consultant who already pays for AI tools, burned by an AI workshop). Red flags per persona.

9. MINOR OBSERVATIONS (bullets).

10. PROVOCATIVE QUESTIONS (2-3 for the founder).

Be specific, evidence-based, no hedging. Quote real text from the bundle with the source file name. Return the full report as your message.`,
  { phase: 'Assessment A: Design + Copy Review' }
);

const assessB = () => agent(
`You are Assessment B in an Impeccable dual-agent critique. You produce DETERMINISTIC + accessibility/performance EVIDENCE only. ISOLATION RULE: do not consider any other agent's design judgment — run independently.

Repo: ${repo}. You will do three steps.

STEP 1 — DETECTOR (mandatory). Run this shell command and capture FULL JSON output:
  node /home/alex/.pi/agent/skills/impeccable/scripts/detect.mjs --json src
Exit 0 = clean, 2 = findings. Report: total count, per-rule counts, rule names, and the file:line list for every finding (do NOT drop the locations). If the script is missing or errors, report the exact error and "deterministic scan unavailable", then continue.

STEP 2 — BROWSER (do NOT fabricate). You have no native browser-canvas tool in this subagent sandbox and headless Playwright/Puppeteer is not reliably available here. SKIP browser injection and report exactly: "Browser visualization skipped: no native browser-canvas tool exposed; headless browser not available in subagent sandbox." Do not start live-server. Do not claim an overlay ran.

STEP 3 — STATIC A11y/PERF EVIDENCE. Read ${bundlePath} (one file) which has per-file copy, heading tags, aria/alt/role/tabIndex, className samples, and flags (client/motion/reducedMotion/outlineNone/focusVis/onClickOnly). Report concrete findings (file + what) grouped:
  a. Images without alt / empty alt on meaningful images.
  b. Form inputs without visible labels / aria-label / required indication (assessment answers + email capture).
  c. Heading order issues (skipped levels, multiple h1).
  d. Click-only interactive elements (onClickOnly flag) lacking keyboard handler/role/tabIndex.
  e. Focus indicators: outline-none present without focus-visible replacement? focus-visible/ring present?
  f. Color-only meaning.
  g. "use client" over-use / large un-lazy assets / hero CLS-LCP risk / motion-heavy sections.
  h. reduced-motion: which animated sections respect prefers-reduced-motion vs which do not (use reducedMotion flag + motion count per file).

Return structured: (1) Detector findings (counts, rule names, file:line list, or unavailable error); (2) Browser (the exact skip sentence); (3) Static a11y/perf evidence a-h with file refs; (4) Likely detector false positives vs DESIGN.md (intentional HP choices); (5) Any skipped step + concrete reason. Evidence only, no design opinions.`,
  { phase: 'Assessment B: Detector + Browser Evidence' }
);

const [a, b] = await parallel([assessA, assessB]);
log('A=' + a.length + ' chars  B=' + b.length + ' chars');
return '===ASSESSMENT A===\n' + a + '\n\n===ASSESSMENT B===\n' + b;

# Assessment A — Design + Copy Review

## 1. DESIGN-SPECIFICITY VERDICT

The copy in the trust-critical sections is unmistakably this product: AboutMeSection crystallizes the thesis ("The measure of my work is how little you need me next."), ServicesSection names it ("From Dependency to Independence"), WhatThisIsNotSection enacts it ("I'd rather lose a sale than take on work I can't deliver."), and EmailCapture honors it ("Skip and see my results"). The visual language is also on-spec — single HP Electric Blue signal (`bg-hp-electric` in ConnectSection/ResultPage), navy slabs (`bg-hp-deep` in AboutMeSection/AssessmentCtaSection/Footer), mono eyebrows, `font-display`/`font-heading` hierarchy. BUT the section *architecture* is generic: LogoBannerSection's logo wall, ROICalculatorSection's "How Many Hours Could You Save?", TestimonialsSection's carousel, MentoringSection's 4-pack pricing, SubstackSection's newsletter CTA — these patterns transplant to any consultant/SaaS site unchanged. Strikingly, the differentiating hook itself ("the last AI consultant you'll ever hire") appears nowhere in static copy; HeroSection's value frame is a cycling `headline.line1/line2` whose content isn't even in the bundle.

**Verdict: Partially.** Copy grounded, architecture borrowable.

## 2. NIELSEN HEURISTICS (0–4)

1. **Visibility of System Status — 4.** Strong throughout: QuizProgress (`role="progressbar"`, "Question X" tabular-nums), ROICalculatorSection ("Select at least one task to see your estimate."), EmailCapture ("Results sent! … Loading your results now..."), ConnectSection ("Sending..."), InsightsSection ("Loading articles..."). Every async/empty state is surfaced.
2. **Match System/Real World — 3.** Mostly plain ("Book a Call", "15 minutes. No pitch. Just clarity."), but abstractions creep in: MentoringSection "Navigating the edge", ConnectSection "The edge of change is real", AboutMeSection "vendor-agnostic judgment". A time-poor skeptic stalls on "the edge."
3. **User Control & Freedom — 4.** QuizQuestion "Previous question" back button; ResultPage "Retake the assessment" + "You can stop anytime. No locked-in commitment."; EmailCapture "Skip and see my results" (refuses to gate the score); ROI steppers. Exemplary escape hatches.
4. **Consistency & Standards — 2.** Same booking action carries ≥5 labels: Header "Book Call"/"Book"/"Book a Call", HeroSection "Book a Free AI Clarity Call", ROICalculatorSection "Book a Call to Discuss Your Estimate", CaseStudiesSection "Talk Through Your Situation", SpeakingSection "Request a Session". Radii also drift (`rounded-md`/`rounded-lg`/`rounded-xl` on buttons vs spec's 4px).
5. **Error Prevention — 3.** ROI gates on task selection; EmailCapture validates (`text-destructive` error class, `role="alert"`); form "Sending…" prevents double-submit. No visible guard against ROI team-size = 0.
6. **Recognition over Recall — 4.** Sticky Header persists nav; assessment is one-question-per-step with visible options; FAQ accordion; no memorization required.
7. **Flexibility & Efficiency — 3.** MentoringSection USD/EUR toggle, skip-link in layout, keyboard focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-primary`), assessment skip. No visible "resume" for interrupted sessions.
8. **Aesthetic & Minimalist Design — 3.** Restrained palette and type, but 14+ sections carry redundancy (AssessmentCtaSection + ServicesSection + ConnectSection all push the assessment) and SubstackSection `motion:24` is the busiest section on the page.
9. **Error Recovery — 3.** `role="alert"` on form failures, InsightsSection error state, but no visible "try again" copy for a failed send beyond the alert role.
10. **Help & Docs — 3.** FAQSection "Real questions people ask me" doubles as help; appropriate for a marketing surface (no docs needed).

## 3. COGNITIVE LOAD

**(a) Decision points >4 options:** ConnectSection stacks four paths on one panel — "Book a Call", "Questions? Text Me on WhatsApp", "Take the 3-minute assessment", and a full contact form ("Or tell me what's on your mind and I'll write back" with name/email/message). That is a >4-option decision at the highest-stakes moment.

**(b) 5-second first-action clarity failures:** HeroSection offers three CTAs simultaneously ("Book a Free AI Clarity Call" / "See Coaching & Services" / "Or message on WhatsApp") over a cycling headline (`headline.line1`/`headline.line2`) — if frame 1 isn't the value prop, the differentiator never lands in the first 5s. The brand hook ("last AI consultant you'll ever hire") is absent from every static string in the bundle.

**(c) Icon-only elements without visible text:** Header WhatsApp button (`aria-label="WhatsApp"`, `min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]`, icon `h-5 w-5`) — glyph-only, no visible word. Footer LinkedIn/Substack (`aria-label` present, no visible label). TestimonialsSection prev/next (`aria-label="Previous testimonial"`). ROICalculatorSection steppers (`aria-label="Decrease team size"`). All have aria-labels (good a11y) but a first-impression user must recognize the glyphs.

**(d) Jargon assuming prior knowledge:** AboutMeSection "vendor-agnostic judgment"; MentoringSection/ConnectSection "the edge" / "edge of change"; "mental models" recurs across ServicesSection/MentoringSection/AboutMeSection.

## 4. EMOTIONAL JOURNEY (peak-end, top→bottom)

Walked inferred order: Header → Hero → LogoBanner → AboutMe → KeyStats → Services → Mentoring → CaseStudies → Testimonials → ROICalculator → WhatThisIsNot → Speaking → Insights → Substack → FAQ → AssessmentCta → (Assessment flow) → Connect → Footer.

- **Peaks:** Hero promise ("No pressure. No pitch. Just clarity."); AboutMeSection "The measure of my work is how little you need me next." (peak trust — the thesis in one line); WhatThisIsNotSection "I'd rather lose a sale…" (peak honesty); ResultPage "You can stop anytime. No locked-in commitment." (reassurance exactly when commitment anxiety peaks).
- **Valleys:** LogoBannerSection early — a logo wall ("Select engagements") reads as social-proof padding to a skeptical buyer. MentoringSection's 4-pack pricing (Single/5-pack/10-pack/20-pack) triggers decision stress and course-platform echoes. ROICalculatorSection is the most SaaS-flavored moment — "How Many Hours Could You Save?" is the metric-card pattern the anti-references warn against.
- **Reassurance at high-stakes moments:** EmailCapture pairs "No spam. Your data stays private." with "Skip and see my results" — the email capture is optional, honoring "no email to see score." ResultPage repeats "15 minutes. No pitch. Just clarity on your next step."
- **Does "exit as goal" survive the funnel?** In copy, yes — AboutMe/Services/WhatThisIsNot/ResultPage all reinforce independence. In *architecture*, no — the funnel ends on a four-channel hard sell (call + WhatsApp + assessment link + contact form) in ConnectSection, and ROICalculatorSection funnels a self-serve tool into "Book a Call to Discuss Your Estimate." The exit thesis is spoken but the closing action is retention.

## 5. COPY AUDIT

**Anti-slop violations (kill-list):**
- MentoringSection: "Navigating the edge isn't a solo endeavor" — **"Navigating"** is on the kill list. Plus "the edge" is a vague abstraction.

No other kill-list words found (no unlock/leverage/seamless/robust/journey/landscape/delve/etc.).

**Em-dash density:** Compliant. One-per-paragraph max observed — SpeakingSection "No keynote fluff—just structured conversations"; WhatThisIsNotSection "You already know what to do — you just want someone to confirm it" and (separate paragraph) "I'll tell you — and point you toward someone who is"; HeroSection sr-only "Alex Myers — AI Consultant & Instructor". None exceed the cap.

**Voice breaks (hype/corporate/course-platform):**
- SubstackSection: "Weekly essays on AI strategy, organizational change, and the future of work." — "the future of work" is corporate-cliché, and it sits beside "No hype, just signal" (which then rings slightly hollow).
- MentoringSection: 4-pack pricing (Single/5-pack/10-pack/20-pack) + "Compare what's inside" / "Side-by-side feature comparison" / "Expand"/"Collapse" — this is course-platform register (feature-comparison matrix), exactly the anti-reference.
- HeroSection: "hundreds of hours of coaching delivered" — boast register, not the direct/warm/expert voice.

**Unverifiable claims (violates density of fact):**
- HeroSection: "hundreds of hours of coaching delivered" — vague boast, no verification path.
- HeroSection: "10–20 hrs/week reclaimed per client" vs AboutMeSection: "The systems to reclaim 10+ hours a week." — the range conflicts ("10–20" vs "10+"); a skeptic notices.
- KeyStatsSection: "Names of recent clients withheld by request" — honest, but leaves "Proof" with no verifiable proof.
- CaseStudiesSection: "Three recent projects. Anonymized and composited." — composited case studies undercut literal proof.
- SpeakingSection alt: "Alex Myers presenting at Sunsetpreneurs 2026 on AI strategy" — a 2026 engagement described in present-progressive; verify or rephrase.

**Missing "exit" framing (CTAs selling retention over independence):** Body copy carries exit framing strongly, but every terminal CTA sells the *entry* to the relationship: "Book a Call", "Book a Free AI Clarity Call", "Book a Call to Discuss Your Estimate", "Request a Session", "Talk Through Your Situation". None name the independence outcome. ConnectSection closes the page on four contact channels rather than one self-sufficiency next-step.

**Clarity (jargon/vague abstraction a skeptic skips):**
- "the edge" / "edge of change" (MentoringSection, ConnectSection) — undefined metaphor.
- "vendor-agnostic judgment" (AboutMeSection) — insider jargon.
- "mental models" (ServicesSection/MentoringSection/AboutMeSection) — overused; verges on workshop vocabulary a burned buyer distrusts.

**COPY-HEALTH verdict: Needs Work** (strong voice in the trust sections, isolated but real slop).

**Top copy issues ranked:**
1. MentoringSection "Navigating the edge isn't a solo endeavor" — kill-list word + vague metaphor.
2. HeroSection stat conflict and boast — "hundreds of hours" + "10–20 hrs/week" vs AboutMe "10+".
3. CTA label drift — one booking action, five labels (consistency + trust cost).
4. ConnectSection closing copy sells retention (4 channels) where the brand promises exit.

5. **Closing funnel undercuts exit-as-goal** — page ends on a four-channel hard sell after an independence-themed journey. *Fix:* close on one low-friction, independence-echoing step, e.g., "Start with the assessment — no call required."
